Third-party software in this package
====================================

mw3.exe and mw3import.exe use the libraries below; mw3indeo.exe uses only
Windows' own and the Indeo 5 codec in your MechWarrior 3 install (not
included). Each library's own licence files, as its release shipped them,
are in licenses\ under the folder the library came in. Thank you to all of their authors.


SDL 3 (SDL3.dll)
----------------
Simple DirectMedia Layer, https://www.libsdl.org/
Copyright (C) 1997-2026 Sam Lantinga and others. zlib licence
(licenses\SDL3-*\LICENSE.txt).


SDL_ttf 3 (SDL3_ttf.dll)
------------------------
https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL_ttf. Copyright (C) 1997-2025 Sam Lantinga
and others. zlib licence (licenses\SDL3_ttf-*\LICENSE.txt).
Its release DLL has these built in:
- FreeType, under the FreeType License (FTL),
  https://freetype.org/license.html.
  Portions of this software are copyright (C) The FreeType Project
  (www.freetype.org). All rights reserved.
- HarfBuzz, MIT licence ("Old MIT"), https://github.com/harfbuzz/harfbuzz.
- PlutoSVG and PlutoVG, MIT licence, https://github.com/sammycage/plutosvg.


SDL_sound 3 (SDL3_sound.dll)
----------------------------
https://github.com/icculus/SDL_sound. Copyright (c) 2001-2026 Ryan C. Gordon
and others. zlib licence (licenses\SDL3_sound-*\LICENSE.txt).
Its built-in decoders have their own terms:
- dr_mp3, dr_flac and dr_wav (David Reid): public domain (Unlicense), or
  MIT-0.
- stb_vorbis (Sean Barrett): public domain, or MIT.
- libmodplug (Olivier Lapicque and others): public domain.
- TiMidity (Copyright (C) 1995 Tuukka Toivonen): the Perl Artistic
  License. The standard version, unmodified by this package, is in
  SDL_sound's source, src/timidity/, with its COPYING file.


FFmpeg (avcodec, avformat, avutil, swscale), version 8.1.2
----------------------------------------------------------
https://ffmpeg.org/. The FFmpeg developers. GNU Lesser General Public
License, version 2.1 or later (licenses\ffmpeg-8.1.2-win64-lgpl-shared\).
Used by mw3import.exe, which converts your disc's movies on the first
start. Built unmodified from ffmpeg.org's release tarball
ffmpeg-8.1.2.tar.xz, with only the AVI demuxer, the Indeo 5 decoder, the
MPEG-1 video encoder and muxer, swscale and the file protocol enabled (no
GPL or non-free parts, no other library inside); the configure line is in
licenses\ffmpeg-configuration.txt and the project's docs/deps.md.
mw3import.exe loads the DLLs dynamically: you may replace them with your
own build of the same version.


Liberation Sans, Liberation Mono and Anton (assets\fonts)
---------------------------------------------------------
Stand-ins for an install without the game's Arial, Lucida Console and Impact.
Liberation: Copyright (c) 2010 Google Corporation, Copyright (c) 2012 Red Hat,
Inc., https://github.com/liberationfonts/liberation-fonts. Anton: Copyright
2020 The Anton Project Authors, https://github.com/googlefonts/AntonFont.
SIL Open Font License 1.1 (licenses\liberation\OFL.txt,
licenses\anton\OFL.txt). Unchanged, under their reserved names.


Saira Condensed Bold (assets\launcher\font.ttf)
------------------------------------------------
The launcher's lettering. Copyright 2016 The Saira Project Authors,
https://github.com/Omnibus-Type/Saira. SIL Open Font License 1.1
(licenses\saira-condensed\OFL.txt). Unchanged, under its reserved name.


miniz's inflate, tinfl (built into mw3.exe)
-------------------------------------------
Rich Geldreich, RAD Game Tools and Valve Software,
https://github.com/richgel999/miniz. MIT licence (licenses\miniz\LICENSE).
It reads the official 1.2 patch.

pointed at: zip, 7z, RAR, tar and disc images.

zlib 1.3.1 (built into mw3.exe and mw3import.exe)
-------------------------------------------------
https://zlib.net/. (C) 1995-2022 Jean-loup Gailly and Mark Adler. zlib
licence (licenses\zlib-1.3.1\LICENSE). libarchive's deflate (zip).


liblzma from XZ Utils 5.8.1 (built into mw3.exe and mw3import.exe)
------------------------------------------------------------------
https://tukaani.org/xz/. Lasse Collin and the XZ Utils contributors. liblzma
is under the BSD Zero Clause License, 0BSD (licenses\xz-5.8.1\COPYING.0BSD;
licenses\xz-5.8.1\COPYING says which licence covers which part of XZ
Utils: only liblzma is used). libarchive's LZMA and LZMA2 (7z, xz).


Microsoft Visual C++ runtime (msvcp140.dll, vcruntime140*.dll)
---------------------------------------------------------------
Redistributable files of Microsoft Visual Studio, included as its licence
allows for programs built with it. Copyright (C) Microsoft Corporation.

MechWarrior 3
-------------
None of the game's files are in this package; the program reads your own
install. MechWarrior is a trademark of its owner; this project is not
affiliated with or endorsed by its owner.
